items.stem: Your two motion blocks are near each other but the character only does the first action. Why?

options.text: The blocks are not snapped together, so only the first one runs
options.rationale: Correct: blocks must be connected to run as a sequence.
It is usually a snapping problem, not a broken tablet.

options.text: Characters can only ever do one thing
options.rationale: Characters can do many actions when blocks are joined.
